title: Atlas DataFlow Build Evidence
description: Reduced build evidence for candidate artifact generation. This schema covers pipeline-side evidence only and must not include raw logs, raw runtime data, raw API payloads, secrets, private source paths, raw artifact contents, publisher promotion evidence, or registry mutation evidence.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this reduced build evidence document.

producer.description: Pipeline component that produced the build evidence.

source_input.description: Reduced identity of the source contract input used for candidate assembly.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset identifier from the source contract input.

release_id.description: Stable release identifier from the source contract input.

path.description: Reduced source contract input path reference. Must not contain raw source content or private source path details.

publisher_validation.description: Reduced publisher compatibility validation status. Raw role results, identifier details, and schema compatibility details are intentionally excluded.

valid.description: Reduced boolean status copied from the publisher validation result.

validated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when build evidence captured the validation status.

build_boundary_confirmations.description: Pipeline-side boundary confirmations for candidate assembly.

promotion_occurred.description: Candidate build evidence must never claim publisher promotion occurred.

registry_mutation_occurred.description: Candidate build evidence must never claim registry mutation occurred.

evidence_policy.description: Safety policy for reduced build evidence. All flags are required and fixed.

assembled_artifacts.description: Candidate package-relative artifact paths assembled for the release candidate, excluding build-evidence.json itself.

items.description: Candidate package-relative path reference. Must not embed raw artifact contents.
